adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, the mutation first persists new attendees via `prisma.booking.update({ data: { attendees: { createMany: ... }}})` and only afterwards calls `await eventManager.updateCalendarAttendees(evt, booking);` without any surrounding `try/catch` or transactional rollback. If `updateCalendarAttendees` throws, the TRPC mutation will error back to the client while the DB changes (new attendees) remain committed; additionally, the email sending is after that call and thus would not run, leaving guests saved without calendar sync/emails.
